CONCERN (unresolved, the reason for Note+risk): hro_seen Bill leg. Protocol U has Rafael open Tomas's new conversation at its newest message and leaves his page there ('With it still open at its newest message, Tomas sends one more: it appears, and Rafael's count and total do not rise'; readings are 'without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page'). Later: 'Tomas then sends a message and, with his page left open, Bill Okafor ... opens the conversation: Tomas's message shows as seen on Tomas's page'. In the golden, Rafael's still-open page auto-reads that message on arrival (threads.js:157 catchUp -> markRead when active and at bottom; threads.js:212), which advances a recruiter read marker, and seenBoundary for the candidate counts any recruiter (index.js:143-148). So Tomas's page shows 'Seen' about one second after sending, BEFORE Bill opens. That is correct under hireops_rules.md:164-166, but hro_seen says 'Fails if seen is shown too early' and the functional prompt says 'Record before/after facts per row'; a judge that records the before-state may score the golden 0 on this 1.5-weight row. Same structure for the following leg ('Tomas sends one more and Rafael opens the conversation') where Rafael already has it open. A similar exposure exists for the first leg if the judge keeps Tomas's independent context open on the conversation after his sends (the golden would then mark Rafael's message Seen before Aud/Tomas-open). The scripted evidence does not exercise this: workspace.cjs:266-268 uses API calls with no staff page open and asserts only the after-state. This is a protocol/criterion sequencing defect rather than a golden gap (the golden implements the rule), hence Note not Fail; it also makes the Bill leg non-discriminating (an app ignoring manager reads would pass), which belongs to rows 30/39.

MISSING EVIDENCE: no configured full judge run, no Oracle score and no judge-duration measurement exist (raw-evidence-index scope says so explicitly); the scripted driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would' (e.g. the exact B-protocol sequence steps 1-15, the A-protocol completeness after all protocols, visual likert levels). Plausibility from source is established; a high oracle score is not measured.
counterexample: Golden under functional protocol U: Rafael's supplied page has Tomas's new J2 conversation open at newest; Tomas sends a message; within ~1 s Rafael's page POSTs /api/applications/:id/read (threads.js:157/212), Tomas's page receipt becomes 'Seen' (index.js:143-148) before Bill opens; a judge recording before/after for the Bill leg can mark 'seen shown too early' and give the golden 0 on hro_seen.
suggested_fix: In protocol U, before Tomas sends the message for the Bill leg, have Rafael's page switch to a different conversation or the Board (and say his page's open conversation would legitimately mark it seen), and state in hro_seen that the Bill-leg receipt is read before and after Bill opens with no recruiter page open on it; then run the configured functional judge on the golden to measure the oracle.
